name: OmaTorrent
author: ucmz851
description: High-performance customizable torrent search aggregator and real-time qBittorrent controller for Omarchy Quattro bar. Features user-configurable indexers (Internet Archive, Linux ISO feeds, Jackett/Prowlarr Torznab), magnet launching, and live transfer monitoring.

barWidget.description: Customizable multi-source torrent search aggregator and qBittorrent transfer controller. Search across user-configured indexers with 1-click magnet dispatching.
